title: Greek summer public water and shade map
summary: Maps shade, refill points, clinics, and safer walking routes during Greek summer heat.
content: Greek summer public water and shade map is a practical offline routine for heat movement. Mark fountains, municipal buildings, pharmacies, clinics, shaded parks, churches, supermarkets, and shaded bus stops. Create a morning/evening movement plan and a noon stop rule. Do not assume every fountain is safe after outages or contamination notices. Pair vulnerable people with a buddy during errands. Add backup routes with less uphill walking even when longer.
